title: Bait and switch...buyer beware
text: Having been a FabFitFun subscriber, I was very excited to subscribe to this monthly service. My daughter recommended the service and I followed a link expecting to receive the intro box inclusive of the hot tools blow out brush. I subscribed exactly the same way and about a week after she did. When my box arrived, I was disappointed in the contents. The tool (which I was expecting as a coupon to redeem the same way my daughter had) was not included. When I contacted customer service, they informed me that the promotion had changed and to get this gift I would need to commit to an annual membership. I would NOT recommend this service.
label: negative
